data.name: Touhou Akis' Farm
data.detailed_description:
Prologue


Today, the unpopular yaoyorozu no kami—the Harvest Sisters—still wear gloomy expressions.

"If we don't gain more faith soon, we'll turn into youkai!"
The elder sister, Aki Shizuha, stands up, declaring the crisis they are about to face.

"No need to rush~ We'll figure something out… The sweet potatoes are ready—they're really sweet. Eating something will clear your mind…"
The younger sister, Aki Minoriko, holds up a perfectly roasted sweet potato, speaking in her usual unhurried tone.

Though restless with worry, Shizuha can't resist the aroma. She snatches the potato, shoves it into her mouth, and chews while sitting back down, frustrated with herself.

Indeed, in this era, there are far too many capable gods.
For a useless god like herself, who doesn't even have a shrine, if she keeps failing to gather faith, she'll eventually become a youkai—or in the worst case, simply disappear…

"But gathering faith is just too hard——!!!"

As gods of autumn, blessed with the power of harvest and desolation,
will they continue to sink into mediocrity and aimlessness?

—No. As a player, you won't let that happen. The largest, most vibrant, and most beautiful ultimate ecological farm in Gensokyo is about to be born—through their hands, and yours!

1. Core Gameplay

A brand-new farm simulation management game!

You will play as the two Harvest Sisters, who struggle to gain faith. Make the most of your time each day from 6:00 AM to 2:00 AM to manage your very own farm. Tend to your fields—planting, harvesting, chopping wood, raising animals, and more—while steadily accumulating crops and materials.

Sell your harvest to earn funds for further development, gradually expand your farm, unlock new content, explore new areas, meet new people, and grow into a more capable deity. Then, make your mark at the triennial God Assembly!

2. Rich Characters and In-Game Events


A large cast of original Touhou Project characters will appear in the game. Beyond their charming performances, they will also become part of your daily life. Each character follows their own unique daily schedule, living their lives according to their routines.

Interact with them, build friendships, and gradually become a part of each other's lives. You can learn their personal stories, invite them to help out on the farm, and eventually even ask them to move into your house as permanent guests! That's how you achieve true [s]cohabitation[/s] living together!

The game features numerous character-specific events and beautifully illustrated personal CGs, crafted with heartfelt storytelling and expressive pixel art, ensuring a unique and memorable experience.

3. Revisit the Maps of Gensokyo


As you progress through the game, you'll gradually unlock various iconic locations from the original series, including the Beast's Path, the Human Village,玄武泽 (Genbu Swamp), Youkai Mountain, Wind God Lake, Tengu City, and the Rainbow Dragon Cave. These are places that were not accessible in the previous game, Touhou Mystia's Izakaya. To make up for that遗憾 (regret), we will prioritize featuring maps that were absent in the prequel!

Each map is meticulously drawn, with great care taken to faithfully recreate the settings and details from the original lore.

4. Activities Beyond Farming


In addition to planting and harvesting crops, players can enjoy a variety of other activities, including fishing, animal husbandry, socializing, cooking, mining adventures, setting up stalls at the market, and even voting for your favorite idols in a fan support event! These diverse elements provide a refreshing break and prevent the gameplay from becoming monotonous.

5. Engaging Collection Elements


Collect a wide array of items—crops, animals, mythical creatures, companions, and beautiful outfits—all of which can be viewed and admired in your very own home.
Collecting is, and always will be, one of the most joyful parts of gaming.

6. High-Quality Audio-Visual Presentation


As a pixel art game, we've put tremendous effort into the artistic expression of Touhou Akis' Farm to ensure players never find it lacking in quality.
At the same time, the game's music has been carefully arranged, with every track worthy of a spot on your MP3 playlist.

…

And there are many more surprises waiting for you to discover as you play…
You will eventually become a capable and self-reliant farmer—
one who helps all of Gensokyo appreciate the beauty of food and the happiness of life.

data.short_description: The unpopular goddesses of autumn, the Aki Sisters, are on the brink of becoming youkai due to a lack of faith, or even disappearing entirely! Step into their shoes as you slowly manage and build the biggest and most spectacular Gensokyo-styled eco-farm, giving everyone a slice of bliss and joy!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10
  • Processor: Intel Pentium G5500 / Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750Ti / AMD HD 7790
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Recommended:

  • OS: Windows10
  • Processor: Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
